424-868-8215.description:
Cast Death of a Thousand Stings by paying its mana cost, targeting yourself.
Holding priority, cast Desperate Ritual by paying its splice cost, adding its effects onto Death of a Thousand Stings.
Holding priority, activate Mirror Sheen by paying {1}{U/R}{U/R}, copying Death of a Thousand Stings, which also has the effects of Desperate Ritual, targeting an opponent.
Resolve Death of a Thousand Stings, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life and add {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

4772-6753-6763-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

413-2946-4871-5075.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
413-2946-4871-5075.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Ogre Slumlord and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cult Conscript enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

requires.n: Aura Costing One Mana that Enchants Creatures

3953-4050-6054--163.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with the Aura attached, adding one mana of any color.
Mazzy's second ability triggers, exiling the Aura and allowing you to cast it until your next turn.
Cast the Aura from exile by paying its mana cost, attaching it to any other creature you control.
When the Aura enters, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2724-3557-6432.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Brago. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Doorkeeper Thrull.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

390-703-7149.description:
Cast Hulking Metamorph for its prototype cost by paying {2}{U}{U}. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Hulking Metamorph into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Hulking Metamorph dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Astral Dragon, gaining its abilities.
When Hulking Metamorph enters, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Put all but one of the clones into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Hulking Metamorph tokens each trigger. Resolve a trigger, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 5.
390-703-7149.notes: The additional triggers can copy whatever noncreature permanent(s) you desire.

1722-1912-2034-6705-7365.description:
Activate Katara by paying at most {4} due to Biomancer's Familiar, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create two creature tokens.
Activate Katara by paying at most {2} and tapping the creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Katara ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
1722-1912-2034-6705-7365.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you tap combo pieces or other applicable permanents while activating Katara's waterbend ability the first iteration. As the combo will net {C} each iteration, you can forego sacrificing and/or tapping both tokens on some loops.

1903-2713-3094-4659-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
1903-2713-3094-4659-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {1} due to Zirda and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

2933-4013-4460-5798.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

3259-5659-7296.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5659-7296.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Disa the Restless's second ability.
Resolve the Disa the Restless trigger, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Tarmogoyf token, then causing untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3767-3918-5116-7223.description:
Activate Trazyn using Gilded Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

141-2562-5231.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Graceful Reprieve, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Graceful Reprieve.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1017-3375-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3054-3330-3416-5670.easyPrerequisites: You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
3054-3330-3416-5670.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the Vampire and Oathsworn Vampire enter, Leyline of Vitality triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader twice by paying 2 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire and the Vampire token, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

3652-3698-5220-6900.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
When Ornithopter enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Repeat.

4853-5315-6810.easyPrerequisites: You've sacrificed an artifact this turn.
4853-5315-6810.description:
Activate Detective's Satchel by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the Thopter.
When the Thopter dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Detective's Satchel.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

406-1339-6096.easyPrerequisites: Tandem Lookout paired with General Kreat.
406-1339-6096.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
406-1339-6096.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering General Kreat, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
General Kreat triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2921-3604-5365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue token.
2921-3604-5365.description:
Cast Lonis by paying {1}{G/U}{G/U}.
When Lonis enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Lonis.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.
2921-3604-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

1349-2034-6012.notablePrerequisites:
There is a coin counter on any creature you control except Athreos.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature if Reluctant Role Model is the only creature you control with a coin counter on it.
1349-2034-6012.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Reluctant Role Model's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting a coin counter on it if it wasn't the creature that was sacrificed, or another nontoken creature you control otherwise.
Repeat.

2034-2820-4871-5006.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lurrus, adding {C}{C}.
When Lurrus dies, Angelic Renewal and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Angelic Renewal trigger, causing you to sacrifice it and return Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Cast Angelic Renewal from your graveyard by paying {1}{W}.
Repeat.

3484-4374-5663.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
When Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability and Decoction Module trigger.
Resolve the Decoction Module trigger, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Aethergeode Miner trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat.

3705-5231-5695.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Infested Thrinax triggers, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing the Saprolings, adding {1}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

1074-3129-4222.description:
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping King Macar.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, exiling target creature and creating two Gold artifact tokens.
Activate the Golds by sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat as desired.
You may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

3347-3883-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Lore Broker.
Lore Broker does not have summoning sickness.
3347-3883-4222.description:
Activate Lore Broker by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and create a Treasure artifact token for each opponent you have, then causing each player to discard a card.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Lore Broker.
Repeat.
If you have two or more opponents, this combo nets near-infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

1248-2869-3388.description:
Cast Harald Unties the Elves by paying {2}{B}{G}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a lore counter on it.
Harald Unites the Elves' first chapter ability triggers, causing you to mill three cards, and return Moritte from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Harald Unites the Elves with one lore counter on it.
Put Moritte of the Frost into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Moritte of the Frost's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to mill three cards, and return Moritte from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Harald Unites the Elves with one lore counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

2292-2493-2596-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{B}{B}.
2292-2493-2596-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}{B}.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Archaeomancer and Peregrine Drake, causing you to scry 1 twice.
Cast Living Death by paying {3}{B}{B}, causing each player to exile all creature cards from their graveyard, sacrifice all creatures they control, then return all cards exiled this way to the battlefield.
Archaeomancer and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Living Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands you control.
Repeat.
If the five lands can tap to produce at least {4}{B}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1339-1689-2189-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-1689-2189-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature.
The creature dies, triggering Norn's Wellspring, causing you to put an oil counter on it and draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

215-2792-4115.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{G}{U}.
You have no other Whales on the battlefield or in your graveyard.
215-2792-4115.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{G}{U}.
Cast Great Whale by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Volo triggers, creating a token copy of Great Whale.
The token Great Whale enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{G}{U}.
The nontoken Great Whale enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Temur Sabertooth twice by paying {2}{G}{G}, returning the token and nontoken Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1584-3525-4644.notablePrerequisites:
Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Tidewater Minion.
1584-3525-4644.description:
Activate Teferi's Isle by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Tidewater Minion's last ability by tapping it, untapping Teferi's Isle.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Repeat any number of times.
